Summarize the following passage in one or two sentences: Honeybee populations across North America and Europe have declined sharply over the past two decades. Scientists attribute the losses to a combination of pesticide exposure, parasitic mites, habitat loss, and climate stress. Several countries have responded by restricting certain pesticides and funding habitat restoration programs.

Local businesses have welcomed the plan, although some residents worry the docking stations will take away street parking spaces.

Summarize the following passage in one or two sentences: A large ten-year study published this week found that people who drank two to three cups of coffee per day had a modestly lower risk of heart disease than those who drank none. They also cautioned that adding large amounts of sugar or cream could offset any potential benefit, and that people sensitive to caffeine should not increase their intake.

Residents near the volcano were evacuated as a precaution, though officials reported no injuries so far.
